newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices fall, differentials stay firm.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices fall, differentials stay firm.

text.p: Arabicas in the Bremen physical coffee market were marked down by $9-14 per 50 kg fob on the week in the wake of futures losses but exporters sought to stem the fall by declining to mark down differentials pro rata.
The only exception were Brazils, which rose $1 to $113, but they were still at a heavy discount to other arabicas.
Arabica turnover was thin and restricted to March-June 1997 as early 1997 Colombians and Central Americans were too highly priced to attract buyers, traders said.
Roasters also viewed African arabicas as too expensive.
Robustas were steady to lower without much buying interest.
